Mom, I want you wait just a little longer. BRT.

Do you think Henry's mother correctly understood BRT? Probably not. You can use expressions like BRT (be right there), JK (just kidding), or LOL (laughing out loud) when you text your friends. However, careful with such expressions when you text your teachers or parents. You need to understand that some of them may not know the meanings of such expressions.

I loved your gift. Thanks a lot. J

"Only one smiling face (J)? I guess he didn't like my gift," Jisu thought.

Sometimes, a little emoji like J can speak ⓑ louder than many words. The problem is that not everybody ⓒ uses emojis in the same way. Some people like to use them a lot, and some ⓓ aren't. In addition, the same emojis can mean different things to ⓔ different people.

위 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?
